Bill.BriefDescription: Using environmental mitigation moneys for agricultural preservation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to using environmental mitigation moneys foragricultural preservation; adding a new section to chapter 47.12 RCW;and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that preservation ofagricultural land is important to the state's economy and theenvironment. The legislature intends to add purchase of developmentrights of agricultural land as another option for environmentalmitigation of transportation projects.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purpose of environmental mitigation of transportationprojects, any county may require the department of transportation toparticipate in the county's purchase of development rights program. Ifthe county requires the department's participation, the departmentshall transfer to the county's purchase of development rights programenvironmental mitigation moneys for transportation projects. Rights inperpetuity to future development of any open space land, farm and p. 1 HB 3235agricultural land, and timber land which are so designated by thecounty may be used as environmental mitigation moneys fortransportation projects in lieu of wetlands or other mitigationrequired for a specific transportation project.
